args: echo '=== setup starting ==='; date; echo "host: $(uname -a)"; for i in $(seq 1 20); do echo "[setup] preparing workspace step $i/20"; done; echo 'warning: using default config' >&2; sleep 1; echo '=== setup done ==='

echo '=== build starting ==='; for i in $(seq 1 40); do echo "[build] compiling module_$i.rs ... ok"; if [ $((i % 10)) -eq 0 ]; then echo "[build] progress: $i/40"; sleep 1; fi; done; echo '=== build finished ==='

echo '=== test starting ==='; for i in $(seq 1 30); do echo "[test] running case #$i"; if [ $((i % 7)) -eq 0 ]; then echo "[test] case #$i emitted a warning" >&2; fi; done; sleep 1; echo '[test] 30 passed, 0 failed'; echo '=== test finished ==='

echo '=== lint starting ==='; for f in main config handler router store; do for i in $(seq 1 6); do echo "[lint] $f.rs:$i clean"; done; done; echo '[lint] style nit on store.rs:4' >&2; echo '=== lint finished ==='
echo '=== report ==='; date; for i in $(seq 1 15); do echo "[report] aggregating result $i/15"; done; echo 'SUMMARY: build=ok test=ok lint=ok'; echo '=== pipeline complete ==='
